meta.symfony_proxy: /api/symfony/* forwards remaining browser AJAX until migrated

comment_forms.note: comment.js uses form action/href from Twig-rendered URLs (not FOS expose); migrate with explicit /api/v1/comment/* routes

react.note: Vite proxy /api → Node; prefer /api/v1 for new calls. Implemented in React: FAQ, rules, legal, disclaimer, privacy (stub matches Twig), assembly directory (POST /api/v1/assembly/search), parliament scores (GET /api/v1/parliament/members), home, category hub, category initiative listing (POST /api/v1/category/:type/:id/:slug/search). Twig category DataTables also targets that Node URL. Login/register/profile/user/admin/initiative/otp/resetting remain Symfony mirrors until APIs + auth.

twig_to_react.goal: Fully retire Twig for browser HTML: every user-facing route served as React (SPA or SSR), Symfony reserved for APIs, auth, or temporary proxy until parity.
already_ported_or_superseded: Static copy: templates/default/faq, legal, rules, disclaimer, privacy (React ContentPage)
Data: assembly search, parliament members, category initiative search (Node /api/v1 + React tables; apps.js category DT uses Node)
React shell routes with Symfony fallbacks for auth/admin/user/initiative/otp/resetting
remaining_template_groups: templates/base.html.twig + footer + global chrome (nav, search, assets) → one React AppLayout matching design
templates/default/index.html.twig + Widget/* (hero, sidebars, trending, categories overview, etc.) → homepage APIs + React widgets
templates/Category/*.html.twig (overview pages, not only per-category table) → list APIs + React
templates/Vote/* (show, vote, result, forms) → initiative APIs + React; highest risk (encryption, POST flows)
templates/User/*, Profile/*, registration/*, security/*, Resetting/*, ChangePassword, Delegation → auth strategy then forms in React
templates/Admin/* → admin JSON + React admin app (ROLE checks)
templates/Menu/*, Helpers/*, FOSUserBundle/views/* → absorbed into React layout or removed when bundles unused
plaintext_email_twigs: *.txt.twig (registration, resetting, vote notify) — usually keep server-side or move to ESP templates; not the same as browser Twig migration
blocking_dependencies: Decide SPA (Vite only) vs SSR (Next/Remix) for SEO on /initiative/{id}/{slug} and category pages
Session or token strategy for all ROLE_USER / ROLE_ADMIN mutations before turning off Twig forms
Reverse proxy: serve frontend/dist index.html for migrated paths while Symfony handles /api and unmigrated routes during cutover
suggested_order: 1) Homepage widget APIs + React homepage (replaces default/index + most Widget partials)
2) Initiative read path + vote/comment APIs + React initiative page (replaces Vote/show + vote.js)
6) Remove Twig extends for migrated routes; final proxy removal
